question: Which of the following statement regarding the Deccan Plateau is correct?

options.text: The Deccan Plateau has almost the same height through its expanse.
The Deccan Plateau is higher on the east and west ends and slopes towards the center.
The Deccan Plateau is higher in the west and slopes gently eastwards.
The Deccan Plateau is higher in the east and slopes gently westwards.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Deccan Plateau is higher in the west and slopes gently eastwards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Deccan Plateau covers the majority of the southern part of the country.
 
• The Deccan Plateau is a triangular landmass that lies to the south of the river Narmada.
 
• It is located between three mountain ranges and extends over eight Indian states.
 
• The Plateau covers 422000 sq. km area.
 
• In the south, the plateau is mostly over 1,000 meters above sea level. In the north, it is mostly about 500 m above sea level.
 
• **The Deccan Plateau is higher in the west and slopes gently eastwards.**
 
• One of the distinct features of the Deccan plateau is the black soil area known as Deccan Trap.
